mapper.update: UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='PROCESSING', updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{alertId} AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')

UPDATE stock s JOIN order_item oi ON oi.product_id=s.product_id SET s.reserved_quantity=s.reserved_quantity-oi.quantity, s.sold_quantity=s.sold_quantity+oi.quantity, s.updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE oi.order_id=#{orderId} AND s.reserved_quantity >= oi.quantity

UPDATE point_balance pb JOIN orders o ON o.member_id=pb.member_id JOIN payment p ON p.order_id=o.id SET pb.balance=pb.balance + ROUND(p.amount * 0.05), pb.updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM point_ledger pl WHERE pl.order_id=o.id AND pl.type='EARN')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement(payment_id, vendor_id, amount, pg_fee_amount, platform_fee_amount, net_amount, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT p.id, pr.vendor_id, p.amount, ROUND(p.amount*0.029), ROUND(p.amount*0.05), p.amount-ROUND(p.amount*0.029)-ROUND(p.amount*0.05), 'PENDING', NOW(6), NOW(6) FROM payment p JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id=p.order_id JOIN product pr ON pr.id=oi.product_id WHERE p.id=#{paymentId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM settlement s WHERE s.payment_id=p.id)
